Buckhead Capital Management Upped Its Pepsico (PEP) Position; 10 Analysts Are Bullish Open Text (OTEX) Last Week
April 30, 2018 - By Stephen Andrade
Among 12 analysts covering OpenText Corporation ( NASDAQ:OTEX ), 10 have Buy rating, 1 Sell and 1 Hold. Therefore 83% are positive. OpenText Corporation had 26 analyst reports since July 30, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. The firm earned “Overweight” rating on Tuesday, January 24 by Barclays Capital. The stock has “Buy” rating by RBC Capital Markets on Wednesday, July 12. BMO Capital Markets maintained Open Text Corporation (NASDAQ:OTEX) rating on Thursday, February 1. BMO Capital Markets has “Buy” rating and $42.0 target. As per Thursday, February 16, the company rating was initiated by Citigroup. The rating was maintained by RBC Capital Markets on Monday, October 30 with “Buy”. Barclays Capital maintained it with “Overweight” rating and $43 target in Friday, August 4 report. The firm earned “Buy” rating on Tuesday, September 26 by RBC Capital Markets. The firm earned “Buy” rating on Wednesday, November 22 by Raymond James. RBC Capital Markets upgraded Open Text Corporation (NASDAQ:OTEX) on Thursday, July 30 to “Outperform” rating. Open Text Corporation provides a suite of software services and products that assist organizations in finding, utilizing, and sharing business information from various devices. The company has market cap of $9.42 billion. The firm offers content solutions that provide content and records management, archiving, and email management and capture solutions, as well as Core, a software as a service based multi-tenant cloud solution; business process management for analyzing, automating, monitoring, and optimizing structured business processes; and customer experience management products, which offer Web content management, digital asset management, customer communications management, social software, and portal. It has a 49.43 P/E ratio. The Company’s products also include business network solutions comprising business-to-business integration, fax solutions, and secure messaging; analytics solutions, including embedded reporting and visualization, and big data analysis; and discovery solutions consisting of search, semantic navigation, and auto classification, as well as InfoFusion to deal with the issue of Â‘information silosÂ’ resulting from disconnected information sources across the enterprise.
